checkpoints.note: First project-code materialization point on the crashing path. `PDFDoc::setup` passes the attacker-controlled bytes into Poppler's xref parser, which records the malformed trailer's `/Root 6 0 R` and trailing `startxref 8` for later object fetch and recovery logic.

The staged fix scopes `entry` to separate start/end blocks and reacquires `xref->getEntry(objNum, false)` only at cleanup, so the `getEntry -> readXRefUntil -> constructXRef` path can no longer leave one stale pointer live until this guard.
